bio_en: Ghazar Kocharyan, known as Kachal Ghazar, was born in Bashgarni in 1874 and, disguised as a modest village shopkeeper, became the 'revolutionary smith' of Bashgarni's youth. He formed the young fighters Martiros Abrahamian, Khnko, Smbat and his nephew Artush, all later notable band leaders, and took them with him in Mihran's band in the 1904 Mosun and Zor expedition, asking that they be kept back as standard-bearers. He served in the armed bands, the volunteer units and under the Republic wherever the ARF called. He died at an advanced age, mourned in two 40th-day eulogies.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year not given (eulogies published in Alik, Tehran; #23 in Alik's 34th year, c.1964-65).
